1.title: A voice through the static
1.recap: Our journey begins at the workshop bench.
paragraphs: I pull a stool up to the bench and turn the console towards you. Outside, the clocktower marks another quiet evening in Hill Valley. On the wall, a diagram from 1955 waits beside my plans for the first jump.
You ask the console where we should go. It answers immediately, with a destination that does not exist. I set my notebook beside the screen.
“We have a voice,” I tell you. “Now let’s understand what’s answering before we ask it to guide us.”
1.obstacle: Understand what the console can do—and where its answers need care.

9.title: The route between the switches
9.recap: The first chapter introduced the console’s voice, conversation record and tools.
paragraphs: I open the service-bay door. Beyond the square, traffic passes above the streets; inside, a row of switches waits on the workbench. Each one works on its own. Together, they still have no route to follow.
You reach for the first switch. I lay two station cards between us and draw a line from one to the other.
“Start here,” I say. “Before we ask the console to decide anything, let’s make two simple steps run in the right order.”
9.obstacle: Connect two stations into one dependable sequence.

17.title: The sealed archive
17.recap: The second chapter connected operations and introduced a pause for human approval.
paragraphs: I spread the old workshop journals across the bench. Outside, a locomotive waits beside the unfinished station. Our console can follow a route, but the next repair depends on instructions it has never seen.
You ask it a question. The answer sounds convincing. I open a journal beside the screen and point to a different instruction.
“Before we trust that answer, let’s find the page that supports it,” I tell you. “The way home may already be written down. We need to know where to look.”
17.obstacle: Find the relevant instructions before asking for an answer.
